message: Android 0.1.58 (59) is available through the official direct-download lane. Manual update discovery now reads every configured metadata source and selects the highest valid versionCode, so a stale but newer primary endpoint can no longer hide a newer CloudBase or GitHub release. The existing unified external-share staging, content validation, authentication, all-or-nothing commit, recovery, cleanup, 512 MB per-item limit, 1 GB batch limit, and 256 MB free-space reserve remain unchanged. The exact signed APK passed 820 automated tests with zero failures, full lint with zero errors, R8, APK v2 signature, 16 KiB alignment, signing checks, and launch-readiness boundaries. Tencent AppBao currently continues to serve 0.1.53 (54); a store update is a separate submission and review.
